title: US-2-2: Create Account (P1, 5SP)
description: Admin can create accounts with code, name, type, currency, description, is_active. Acceptance: 201 Created; code unique; stored with timestamps; ready for subsequent journal entries.

title: US-2-6: Health & Readiness (P2, 2SP)
description: Health and readiness endpoints implemented. Acceptance: 200 OK with status fields.

title: US-3-4: GraphQL Proxy (P2, 5SP)
description: Add GraphQL proxy service that forwards to REST endpoints. Acceptance: /graphql endpoint returns data consistent with REST; no direct DB access.

title: US-2-7: OpenAPI Docs (P3, 2SP)
description: Swagger/OpenAPI docs generated and accessible. Acceptance: /docs or /swagger.json available and valid.

title: US-3-5: Redis Queue (P3, 5SP)
description: Introduce Redis/Bull for background tasks (notifications, reconciliation). Acceptance: Enqueue/dequeue works; tasks retry on failure.

title: US-2-11: Read-model caching (P2, 3SP)
description: In-memory TTL-based cache for read models. Acceptance: Cache TTL of 5-10s; cache hits reduce DB load.

title: US-3-3: Read models Redis cache (P2, 5SP)
description: Introduce Redis for caching and as a simple message bus. Acceptance: 5-10s TTL caches; Redis streams for cross-process events.

title: US-2-1: Login and RBAC (P1, 3SP)
description: User logs in and obtains JWT with roles/permissions. Acceptance: 200 and token present; token usable for protected endpoints; RBAC evaluated per request.

title: US-2-12: Phase 2 Integration tests (P2, 5SP)
description:
CRUD flows with RBAC and read models. Acceptance: All phase-2 tests pass in CI.

description: Rebuild account_balances from event stream. Acceptance: After replay, balances match expected post-events.

description: Add accounting_events table and append-only events for Accounts. Acceptance: events appended on each state change; replay utility reconstructs balance.
